adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in addGuests.handler.ts lines 68-75, the blacklist is lowercased: `BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.split(',').map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`. However, when filtering guests at line 72-75, the comparison `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` uses the raw `guest` value without lowercasing it. This means if the blacklist contains 'blocked@example.com' and a user submits 'BLOCKED@example.com', the check will pass because 'BLOCKED@example.com' !== 'blocked@example.com'. This is a real security bypass bug.
